SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN my_deals.status = 'completed' AND my_deals.my_role = 'seller' THEN my_deals.agreed_price ELSE 0 END) AS total_earned,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN my_deals.status = 'completed' AND my_deals.my_role = 'seller' THEN 1 END) AS total_completed_sales,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN my_deals.status = 'completed' AND my_deals.my_role = 'seller' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN my_deals.my_role = 'seller' THEN 1 END), 0) AS completion_rate_percent,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN my_deals.status = 'declined' AND my_deals.my_role = 'seller' THEN 1 END) AS total_declined_sales,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN my_deals.status = 'cancelled' AND my_deals.my_role = 'seller' THEN 1 END) AS total_cancelled_sales,

    nlq.my_listings

  ) AS percentage

results.question: 2024-25 school year: were there more new accounts in the fall term or the spring term?
results.sql:
WITH fall_term AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT students.student_id) AS new_accounts
  FROM students
  JOIN calendar ON (students.joined_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date = calendar.day
  WHERE calendar.academic_year = '2024-25'
    AND calendar.semester = 'Fall'
    AND students.account_status = 'active'
    AND students.is_moderator = false
),

  spring_term AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT students.student_id) AS new_accounts
  FROM students
  JOIN calendar ON (students.joined_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date = calendar.day
  WHERE calendar.academic_year = '2024-25'
    AND calendar.semester = 'Spring'
    AND students.account_status = 'active'
    AND students.is_moderator = false
)

SELECT 
  'Fall Term' AS term, 
  fall_term.new_accounts AS new_accounts,
  ROUND((fall_term.new_accounts * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT new_accounts FROM spring_term), 0)), 2) AS percentage_of_spring
FROM fall_term
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Spring Term' AS term, 
  spring_term.new_accounts AS new_accounts,
  ROUND((spring_term.new_accounts * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT new_accounts FROM fall_term), 0)), 2) AS percentage_of_fall
FROM spring_term;
